Do not widen tolerances after observing failures.

A complete PASS would remove the current equity-parity qualification. Continued failure after supported mapping work, or another engine passing the same frozen comparison while Nautilus fails, would justify reopening the destination choice; preserve LEAN as oracle throughout.
